 Gabigol targets more away goals as Santos visit Bragantino 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Gabigol has hit his past nine goals away from Vila Belmiro and will look to extend that streak when Santos visit Bragantino on Monday, seeking to keep the push towards the Libertadores on track.
 The match kicks off at 20:00, Brasília time, at the Cícero de Souza Marques stadium in Bragança Paulista in the 34th round of the Campeonato Brasileiro. Globo.com notes the forward has been central to Santos’ recent surge.
 OneFootball Videos
 His last nine strikes have all come as a visitor, spanning six league games and one Copa Sudamericana outing.
 Of his 11 away league appearances this season for Santos, he failed to score only three times. He started the derbies against Palmeiras and Corinthians, and came off the bench against Flamengo. In the other eight, he found the net.
 Those returns include braces against Mirassol, Grêmio, São Paulo and Internacional, plus goals versus Vasco, Remo, Atlético-MG and Fluminense. In total, 12 of his 15 league goals have arrived away from home.
 He is also chasing milestones. In the Brasileiro, beyond hoping to finish as top scorer, he is close to entering the all-time top five, currently sixth on 134 goals, one behind Zico. Ahead are Edmundo with 153, Romário 154, Fred 158 and Roberto Dinamite 190.
 At Santos in the 21st century, he has moved past Kleber Pereira on 86 and Ricardo Oliveira on 92 this season. He sits third with 109 goals, two short of Robinho, while Neymar leads on 160.
 Source: Globo.com
